reason: Premises liability claim involving pediatric injury with unresolved maintenance/negligence question. Clarification on whether walkway was maintained post-storm is critical to liability defense strategy and reserve estimation.
root_cause: Claimant did not clearly confirm whether the walkway was properly maintained/cleared after the ice storm, which is essential to establishing negligence in this premises liability claim.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.cause_of_incident: slip and fall on icy walkway

recommended_action: Human adjuster should contact claimant to explicitly establish (1) timeline of when ice formed, (2) when/if walkway was cleared or salted, (3) any prior complaints or notice of the hazard. Interview neighbor to establish timeline of injury and whether child was lawfully on premises.
